problem.title: Merge Intervals
problem.statement: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping intervals that cover all of the input. Intervals that touch (one ends where the next starts) overlap. Return them in any order.

events.text: I need to merge overlapping intervals and return the merged list. What approaches are there?
Compare every pair repeatedly until nothing merges, or sort by start and do one pass.
I'll go with the faster one. Any pitfalls in how I update state?
Update the result after adjusting your pointers or map, not before.
What edge cases should I check now that my code passes the examples?
Try the smallest inputs, duplicates, and the boundaries described in the constraints.
